TREVPAR_WEEK.label: Weekly TRevPAR
TREVPAR_WEEK.meaning: Weekly total revenue per available room.

TAXA_OCUPACAO.label: Occupancy rate
TAXA_OCUPACAO.meaning: Percentage of available room capacity occupied.

N_REVIEWS.label: Number of reviews
N_REVIEWS.meaning: Number of reviews associated with the hotel-week.

SENTIMENT_SCORE_AVG.label: Average sentiment
SENTIMENT_SCORE_AVG.meaning: Average sentiment score extracted from review text.

EXPECTATION_EXPERIENCE_GAP_AVG.label: Expectation–experience gap
EXPECTATION_EXPERIENCE_GAP_AVG.meaning: Average discrepancy between expressed expectations and reported experience.

SEMANTIC_MISALIGNMENT_SCORE_AVG.label: Semantic misalignment
SEMANTIC_MISALIGNMENT_SCORE_AVG.meaning: Average semantic divergence between expectations and reported experience.

EXPECTATION_VIOLATION_RATIO.label: Expectation violation ratio
EXPECTATION_VIOLATION_RATIO.meaning: Share or ratio of expectation-related observations classified as violated.

MAJOR_MISALIGNMENT_SHARE.label: Major misalignment share
MAJOR_MISALIGNMENT_SHARE.meaning: Share of reviews or review structures showing major expectation–experience misalignment.

EMOTION_ENTROPY.label: Emotional complexity
EMOTION_ENTROPY.meaning: Entropy-based heterogeneity of emotions expressed across reviews.

EXPECTATION_SHARE.label: Expectation share
EXPECTATION_SHARE.meaning: Share of reviews containing identifiable expectations.

HIGH_EXPECTATION_SHARE.label: High-expectation share
HIGH_EXPECTATION_SHARE.meaning: Share of reviews containing high-intensity expectations.

HIGH_MISALIGNMENT_SHARE.label: High-misalignment share
HIGH_MISALIGNMENT_SHARE.meaning: Share of observations with high semantic misalignment.

PERC_REVIEWS_NEGATIVE.label: Reviews containing negative/disliked content
PERC_REVIEWS_NEGATIVE.meaning: Percentage of reviews containing a negative or disliked text component. It does not mean that the full review or numerical rating is negative.
PERC_REVIEWS_NEGATIVE.critical_interpretation_warning: Do not interpret this variable as the percentage of guests giving a negative overall evaluation.

PERC_OPERATIONAL_COMPLAINTS.label: Operational complaint share
PERC_OPERATIONAL_COMPLAINTS.meaning: Percentage of complaint content associated with operational or service-delivery issues.

PERC_PRICE_VALUE_MENTIONS.label: Price–value mention share
PERC_PRICE_VALUE_MENTIONS.meaning: Percentage of review content mentioning price or perceived value.

POLARIZATION_INDEX.label: Review polarization
POLARIZATION_INDEX.meaning: Degree to which review experiences are divided or polarized.

COMPLEXITY_INDEX.label: Experience complexity index
COMPLEXITY_INDEX.meaning: Composite indicator of heterogeneous and layered customer experience signals.

SENTIMENT_TREND_SLOPE.label: Precomputed sentiment trend slope
SENTIMENT_TREND_SLOPE.meaning: Trend slope calculated previously in the source panel. Do not confuse it with the case-window trend recalculated by the Case Builder.

topic_summary.interpretation_note: Topic-source metrics must be interpreted separately. experience_weeks may include positive or neutral experiences. violated_expectation_weeks and emerging_negative_weeks indicate negative evidence. negative_review_mentions are based only on review_text_disliked. Cross-structure topic occurrences may refer to the same underlying issue and are not independent complaints.

review_sample.title: Amazing experience and quality place!
review_sample.liked: Hospitality of this place was amazing. You can hardly find so high quality of stuff and welcoming. This is an amazing experience in common. Room was better than we expected, view just unbelievable. You can see city from the top and everything around. Breakfast very tasty and always fresh. Restaurant view also unbelievable. When i come to Lisbon again - definitely only Mundial.

review_sample.title: Perfect!
review_sample.liked: Fantastic location,.incredible views from the rooftop bar and city view rooms. Great choice available for breakfast. Staff extremely helpful and friendly. Would stay again.

review_sample.title: Exceptional
review_sample.liked: The kindness of the staff, the welcome drink, the central location. Spectacular view of the city. Excellent and very varied breakfast. Highly recommended!

review_sample.title: estupenda
review_sample.disliked: Few TV channels: no Spanish, no international, no entertainment channels.

review_sample.title: Good for a short stay.
review_sample.liked: A fairly big room, was quite in a fairly easy location to get get around Lisbon.
review_sample.disliked: Our room overlooked the tram stop and Praça Martim Moniz which meant most nights it was quite noisy with people outside and sirens.

review_sample.title: Excellent location
review_sample.liked: Excellent location, very helpful staff, comfortable bed, very clean.
review_sample.disliked: First day the air conditioning was not working, staff helped us. Breakfast repetitive, no changes at all. Bit too expensive.

review_sample.title: Superb
review_sample.liked: The perfect location since it's central; they gave us some treats on arrival, the staff were very kind and attentive, the rooms were spacious, the bed very comfortable, upstairs there was a bar where you could have a drink quietly with great views of Lisbon, the hotel has its own parking, breakfast was varied and delicious

review_sample.title: Superb
review_sample.liked: Attentive service, very clean room and strategic location. Everything about this hotel makes it worth staying at. I recommend having breakfast (an extraordinary view and abundance with options for every need). Also enjoy the rooftop for an aperitif, one of the best views of the city!

review_sample.title: Uma experiência incrível muito agradável
review_sample.disliked: Beds, baths, bed linen and towels are unthinkable.

review_sample.title: Superb
review_sample.liked: The breakfast and the view are exceptional. The room is very good and comfortable.
review_sample.disliked: Insufficient signage in the corridors inside the hotel. Too many ads when you turn on the television and the remote control had problems (later resolved).

review_sample.title: Exceptional
review_sample.liked: Excellent location, everything nearby, excellent breakfast, clean rooms, helpful staff

review_sample.title: Love Hotel Mundiale
review_sample.liked: We've stayed at Hotel Mundiale several times and love the location and great staff. We love the biscuits/cheeses and port on arrival and before we leave. The breakfasts are amazing.
review_sample.disliked: Having to book in for breakfast although we realise that this has to be done with the renovations in progress.

review_sample.title: Uma experiência muito boa e agradável de hospedagem.
review_sample.liked: Very good breakfast, excellent courtesy of the staff, very good location, great cleanliness, good value for money.
review_sample.disliked: Since the hotel is very large with many corridors, the signage could be better on the floors, indicating exits, reception, and restaurant.

review_sample.title: Very good
review_sample.liked: I especially liked the bed linens and mattress. The bed linens were beautiful, soft cotton, something rare and hotels today. Also my room had a magnificent view of the hillside with the castle on top.

review_sample.title: Pleasant
review_sample.liked: Good location in the middle of the city, although it felt like a troubled neighborhood where we didn't really feel comfortable. Breakfast in the room with a view was wonderful and sufficient; the rooftop terrace bar is highly recommended — great location for it!
review_sample.disliked: The bathroom/shower had a completely clogged drain. The room was merely standard and, unfortunately, no more, which does not seem justified given the overnight prices.

review_sample.title: Very good
review_sample.liked: Excellent location for exploring the city on foot. Delicious breakfast with a wonderful view. Highlight: the rooftop bar! We were a bit unlucky because the hotel was being renovated and we were apparently served at a temporary reception. Everything worked perfectly, but everything looked a bit makeshift (which is understandable and not particularly disturbing). The construction work hardly affected us since we were out during the day anyway. Very nice and attentive staff!
review_sample.disliked: The window was open a crack and there was no way to close it completely, so the street noise was very audible. Poorly resolved: there are no sockets for a phone charger at the bed. Not so favorable: behind the curtain above the windows — mold!

review_sample_metadata.selection_strategy: Neutral recent-review sampling. Reviews are ordered by review_date descending and the most recent reviews are selected. No filtering or ranking based on rating, sentiment, complaint severity or text length is used.
review_sample_metadata.interpretation_warning: The sample represents the most recent reviews in the decision window, not necessarily the full review distribution.

complaints.title: Hotel under renovation
complaints.complaint_text: Disliked: Hotel undergoing renovations. Temporary reception moved to floor 1 was the first warning of things to come. At reception we were asked to provide a time we wished breakfast as breakfast was being served between 2 areas. We were allocated the restaurant on floor 8 which was nice but small resulting in a 15 wait on day 2. Only bar available in the hotel was the roof top bar only accessible by stairs unless you phone ahead to be permitted access from floor 9 as the access door was locked (not ideal for hotel guest with limited mobility). The experience was a nice until the wind picked up. On our second visit to the bar we arrived at 1745. Electing to sit at a lower table rather than high stools were informed that we could not as the area was not covered by staff until 1800. Despite my willingness to serve myself from the bar. It’s table service only. Only resolved following the intervention of the duty manager. The bedrooms are a little tired and this will no doubt be resolved during the renovations which are scheduled for the next three to four months. I have no doubt this hotel will be first class when renovations are concluded but feel let down that we were unaware of them in advance.

complaints.title: Necesario mejor instalaciones. Buena ubicación y amabilidad del personal
complaints.complaint_text: Disliked: Soundproofing problems. You can hear all the noises from inside the hotel and from the street, bearing in mind that my room was on one of the upper floors of the building. It is necessary to set a time for breakfast. The hotel is too large to move to the reception and has different levels to get out to the street, which complicates the stay for people with reduced mobility. Old facilities. It has bathtubs and does not have shower trays. Towels of poor quality and stained, carpeted floors... The equipment and structure could be improved.

complaints.title: A nice hotel but with a very loud rooftop bar
complaints.complaint_text: Disliked: On several nights, there was extremely loud music from the rooftop bar of the hotel. The music was so loud that it was impossible to sleep. It felt like trying to sleep in a discotheque and gave us a headache. So if you prefer quiet evenings and want to go to bed early, I would recommend avoiding that hotel. Honestly, that is the main reason I would not go back there. Everything else was pretty good, but the loud music was unbearable.

complaint_metadata.selection_strategy: Complaint-focused diagnostic sampling. Only reviews with substantive content in review_text_disliked are eligible. Complaints are ranked by lower rating, longer disliked text and recency.
complaint_metadata.interpretation_warning: Selected complaints are diagnostic evidence and are not representative of the complete review distribution. Prevalence should be assessed using the full review-window metadata and managerial evidence.
